verdict.rationale: Pika's own llms.txt and homepage say it offers an API: 'Pika API Club', described as 'One API for 100+ leading video, image, audio, and LLM models' and offered as a membership program. That is first-party, but the pack has no API reference, endpoints, authentication details or SDK docs, so 'documented public API' is only thinly evidenced. It is also unclear whether the API exposes Pika's own apps or only the aggregated models. missing for 10: published API reference and endpoint documentation, authentication and key-provisioning details, evidence that Pika's creative apps (not just third-party models) are API-drivable, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
